assumptions: "===" specifiers are applied as a separate filter pass after normal specifiers
filter() keeps yielding raw items unchanged; only the comparison is string-based

requirements.text: SpecifierSet accepts "===" specifiers and filter() yields items whose raw string exactly equals the "===" operand.
"===" matching never drops raw items because of prerelease handling; it compares strings, not parsed versions.
Tests cover "===" in filter() for matching items, non-matching items, and prerelease-looking raw strings.
